commands.name: tool-refresh
commands.description: Bump or set tool version, pack the local tool, and update or install it in the local tool manifest

options.name: --configuration
options.description: dotnet pack configuration. Default is Release

options.name: --bump
options.description: Version part to increment. Default comes from <ToolRefreshBump> or patch

options.name: --version
options.description:
Set an explicit target version instead of bumping
Notes:
Prefer running this as the installed local tool: dotnet dnrelay-tool tool-refresh
Running tool-refresh through dotnet run can self-lock the apphost during pack.
If the tool is not yet installed in the local manifest, tool-refresh installs it after packing.

arguments.name: PROJECT
arguments.description: Tool project path. Defaults to the single PackAsTool project in the repo
